purpose: development-only fixed R2/R3 feature-budget capacity feasibility diagnostic
rff_rule: Use the first D saved Om/ph rows from the original D=500 realization; z_D = sqrt(500/D) times the first D original features, equivalent to sqrt(2/D) cos(Om_D x + ph_D).
factor_initialization: Saved initial_A first D1 rows and R columns; saved initial_B first D2 rows and R columns; no extra factor rescaling.
cost_scope: Single fixed controller including its own RFF projection/scaling, filtered-x, factor prediction and sequential updates, and one actual output secondary FIR; no selector or candidate branches.
interpretation: Post hoc capacity feasibility only; no parameter or budget selection based on these same outcomes is a validated online method.
